source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 25 (PDF 134-144), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 25 (Organic Synthesis) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define a functional group. Why is organic chemistry studied around functional groups?
(Functional group ki tareef karein. Organic chemistry functional groups ke gird kyun parhi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Functional group organic compound ka woh hissa hai jahan ziyada tar reactions hote hain. Lakhon organic compounds maloom hain magar functional groups sirf chand hain aur har aik compounds ki aik family ki pehchaan hai, is liye organic chemistry inhi ke gird tarteeb di gayi hai.

book_ref.quote: Functional group is a part of organic compound where most of the reactions occur.

blocks.prompt:
2 Why do functional groups play a central role in designing a synthesis?
(Synthesis design karne mein functional groups markazi kirdar kyun ada karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Organic synthesis mein hum saade hisson se target molecule banane ke mukhtalif tareeqe design karte hain. Functional groups chemists ko un reactions ka andaaza aur control dete hain jo aakhir kaar matloob product tak le jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Functional groups play a central role in designing a synthesis.

blocks.prompt:
3 Give two uses of identifying the functional group present in a compound.
(Compound mein maujood functional group pehchanne ke do faide likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Is se compound ki properties (khasusiyaat) ka andaaza hota hai, jo naye organic products banane ke liye zaroori hai. (ii) Is se medicines aur food additives jaise products ki purity aur composition yaqeeni banai jati hai.

book_ref.quote: This information is crucial for the development of new organic products

blocks.prompt:
4 What must be understood before we start preparing an organic compound?
(Organic compound tayyar karna shuru karne se pehle kya samajhna zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har step ke chemical reactions, reagents aur halaat (conditions) samajhna zaroori hai taake target molecule kamyabi se ban sake.

book_ref.quote: it is important to understand the chemical reactions, the reagents, and the conditions

blocks.prompt:
5 State the features of a good synthesis of a substance.
(Kisi substance ki achhi synthesis ki khasusiyaat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Achhi synthesis saste aur aasani se milne wale starting materials ko aise raaste se matloob product mein badalti hai jis mein kam se kam steps hon aur overall yield ziyada ho.

book_ref.quote: adopting a route which involves the least number of steps and gives a high overall yield

blocks.prompt:
6 Into which two categories are the reactions used in organic synthesis divided? Which category is particularly important and why?
(Organic synthesis ke reactions kin do qismon mein baante jate hain? Kaun si qisam khaas ahem hai aur kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh (i) functional group interconversions (FGI) aur (ii) carbon-carbon bond banane wale reactions mein baante jate hain. C–C bond banana khaas ahem hai kyun ke synthesis ki bunyaadi strategy target molecule ko saade aur chhote starting materials se jorna hai.

book_ref.quote: A large variety of organic reactions that can be used in organic synthesis are known.

blocks.prompt:
7 What is meant by synthesis of a target molecule? Does it always take one step?
(Target molecule ki synthesis se kya muraad hai? Kya yeh hamesha aik step mein hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Synthesis mein target molecule saade, bazaar mein milne wale compounds se shuru kar ke banaya jata hai. Yeh hamesha aik step nahi; final target molecule tak pohanchne ke liye kai steps ya tabdeeliyan ho sakti hain.

book_ref.quote: It may involve many steps or transformations to reach the final target molecule.

blocks.prompt:
8 Write the equation for the one-step preparation of a primary aliphatic amine from a haloalkane and state the correct conditions.
(Haloalkane se primary aliphatic amine ki aik-step tayyari ki equation likhein aur durust halaat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: R–CH₂–Cl + NH₃ → R–CH₂–NH₂ + HCl. Haloalkane ko ethanol mein ghuli hui ziyada ammonia ke saath band tube (pressure) mein garam kiya jata hai; CCl₄ shart nahi kyun ke ammonia us mein mushkil se ghulti hai.

book_ref.quote: as the book itself describes in 24.2.

blocks.prompt:
9 Why is a primary alkyl amine usually synthesized in two steps from an alcohol? Show the steps.
(Primary alkyl amine aam taur par alcohol se do steps mein kyun banai jati hai? Steps dikhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Haloalkane aasani se nahi milta jab ke alcohol starting material ke taur par aasani se mil jata hai. R–CH₂–OH → (SOCl₂) R–CH₂–Cl → (NH₃) R–CH₂–NH₂ + HCl.

book_ref.quote: Since haloalkane is not easily available rather it is prepared from an alcohol

blocks.prompt:
10 What is retrosynthesis? Which approach does it use?
(Retrosynthesis kya hai? Is mein kaun sa tareeqa istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Retrosynthesis synthesis ka bilkul ulat hai: target molecule ko kam pecheeda, saade aur aasani se milne wale compounds mein toda jata hai jo starting material ban saken. Is mein disconnection approach istemal hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: It involves the breaking down of the target molecule into less complicated, simpler and more readily available compounds

blocks.prompt:
11 Which bonds are chosen for disconnection in retrosynthesis, and where does a series of disconnections lead?
(Retrosynthesis mein disconnection ke liye kaun se bonds chune jate hain aur kai disconnections kahan le jati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Target molecule ke woh bonds disconnect kiye jate hain jin se structure kaafi saada ho jaye. Aisi kai disconnections ke baad aakhir kaar saade, aasani se milne wale starting materials mil jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Following a series of disconnections, we shall eventually arrive at simple, easily available starting materials.

blocks.prompt:
12 How is the retrosynthetic arrow drawn, and how does it differ in meaning from an ordinary reaction arrow?
(Retrosynthetic arrow kaise banaya jata hai aur is ka matlab aam reaction arrow se kaise mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation: Retrosynthetic arrow

book_ref.quote: Retrosynthetic arrow is an open-ended arrow and denoted by ⇒.

rows: Target molecule se peechhe saade starting materials ki taraf
Khayali disconnection ya FGI dikhata hai, reaction nahi
Reagents se kiya gaya asal reaction dikhata hai

blocks.prompt:
13 What are synthons? Give two examples from the chapter.
(Synthons kya hain? Chapter se do misaalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Synthons target molecule ke woh tukre hain jo disconnection se bante hain; yeh aksar ionic species hote hain aur synthesis ke building blocks hain. Misaalein: nitrobenzene se C₆H₅⁻ (aryl anion) aur NO₂⁺ (nitronium cation); acetophenone se CH₃CO⁺ (acylium cation).

book_ref.quote: Synthons are fragments of the target molecule which are generated by a disconnection.

blocks.prompt:
14 Why can a synthon not be used directly in the laboratory? What is used instead?
(Synthon ko lab mein seedha kyun istemal nahi kiya ja sakta? Is ki jagah kya istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Synthon aam taur par unstable (ghair-mustahkam) hota hai is liye khud istemal nahi ho sakta. Is ki jagah synthetic equivalent (SE) istemal hota hai, yani asal reagent jo synthon ka kaam karta hai, maslan NO₂⁺ ke liye nitric acid.

book_ref.quote: Synthetic Equivalent (SE) is a reagent used to carry out the function of a synthon

blocks.prompt:
15 Define target molecule (TM) and retrosynthetic tree.
(Target molecule (TM) aur retrosynthetic tree ki tareef karein.)
blocks.explanation: Target molecule (TM): woh molecule jise tayyar karna hai. Retrosynthetic tree: woh diagram jo target molecule se starting materials tak tamam mumkina disconnections aur synthons dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: Target Molecule (TM) is the molecule which is to be prepared by disconnection.

blocks.prompt:
16 Define functional group interconversion (FGI) and give the example used in the retrosynthesis of aniline.
(Functional group interconversion (FGI) ki tareef karein aur aniline ki retrosynthesis wali misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: FGI aik functional group ko doosre mein badalna hai taake target molecule tak pohancha ja sake. Aniline ki retrosynthesis mein –NH₂ group ko –NO₂ group mein badla jata hai (aniline ⇒ nitrobenzene).

book_ref.quote: Functional Group Interconversion (FGI) is the conversion of one functional group into another

blocks.prompt:
17 How does FGI help in building complex target molecules?
(FGI pecheeda target molecules banane mein kaise madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: FGI ko building blocks ke taur par istemal kar ke saade starting materials ko ziyada pecheeda target molecules mein badla ja sakta hai. FGI se na sirf TM ka carbon skeleton banta hai balke ikhtiyar kiya jane wala raasta bhi chuna jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Simple starting materials can be converted to more complex target molecules using FGI as building blocks.

blocks.prompt:
18 Can ethanol be converted directly into ethanamide by ammonia? Give reason.
(Kya ethanol ko ammonia se seedha ethanamide mein badla ja sakta hai? Wajah dein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Ammonia alcohol ko amide mein nahi badalti, is liye chhapi hui Figure 25.3 mein ethanol se ethanamide wala NH₃ arrow durust flow sheet se hata diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: ammonia does not convert an alcohol into an amide, so this arrow is left out.

blocks.text: 25.2 Retrosynthesis and Synthesis of Some Compounds

blocks.prompt:
19 Name the synthons and their synthetic equivalents obtained in the retrosynthesis of ethyl acetate.
(Ethyl acetate ki retrosynthesis mein milne wale synthons aur un ke synthetic equivalents ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Ethyl acetate ke synthons aur synthetic equivalents

book_ref.quote: Disconnection at the position indicated will enable us to get synthon A and synthon B

blocks.prompt:
20 What condition must synthetic equivalents satisfy when they are selected?
(Synthetic equivalents chunte waqt unhein kaun si shart poori karni chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Chune gaye synthetic equivalents ko aapas mein react kar ke target molecule dena chahiye; maslan acetic acid aur ethanol react kar ke ethyl acetate dete hain.

book_ref.quote: While selecting synthetic equivalent molecules thus obtained, they should undergo reaction to give the target molecule.

blocks.prompt:
21 Write the equation for the synthesis of ethyl acetate from its synthetic equivalents. Name the reaction and catalyst.
(Ethyl acetate ki us ke synthetic equivalents se synthesis ki equation likhein. Reaction aur catalyst ka naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: CH₃COOH + C₂H₅OH → (H₂SO₄) CH₃COOC₂H₅ + H₂O. Yeh esterification hai aur H₂SO₄ catalyst hai.

book_ref.quote: Here we can design the synthesis of our TM by a very familiar esterification reaction

blocks.prompt:
22 Give reason: in the retrosynthesis of aniline, FGI is carried out before disconnection.
(Wajah batayein: aniline ki retrosynthesis mein disconnection se pehle FGI kyun ki jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Benzene par nitro group electrophilic substitution se aasani se lagta hai, jab ke amino group nucleophilic substitution se nahi. Is liye pehle –NH₂ ko (FGI se) –NO₂ banaya jata hai, phir nitrobenzene disconnect hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Because it is easy to attach nitro group on benzene by electrophilic substitution

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: benzene ring electron se bhari hai, is liye electrophile (NO₂⁺) aasani se lagta hai. Amino group seedha lagana mushkil hai, is liye pehle nitro lagate hain aur baad mein use amino mein badalte hain.

blocks.prompt:
23 Which bond of nitrobenzene is disconnected? Name the synthons and their synthetic equivalents.
(Nitrobenzene ka kaun sa bond disconnect hota hai? Synthons aur un ke synthetic equivalents ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: C–N bond disconnect hota hai jis se aryl anion C₆H₅⁻ aur nitronium cation NO₂⁺ bante hain. In ke synthetic equivalents benzene aur nitric acid hain.

book_ref.quote: In second step the disconnection of nitrobenzene was done from C—N bond

blocks.prompt:
24 Write the retrosynthetic steps of acetophenone, naming the synthons and synthetic equivalents.
(Acetophenone ke retrosynthetic steps likhein aur synthons aur synthetic equivalents ke naam bhi.)
blocks.explanation: Step I: acetophenone ka C–C bond par disconnection, jis se aryl anion C₆H₅⁻ aur acylium cation CH₃CO⁺ milte hain. Step II: in ko neutralize karne se synthetic equivalents benzene aur acyl chloride (CH₃COCl) milte hain.

book_ref.quote: In first step the disconnection of acetophenone (TM) was done from C—C bond

blocks.prompt:
25 How is acetophenone synthesized from benzene? Give the equation.
(Benzene se acetophenone kaise banaya jata hai? Equation dein.)
blocks.explanation: Friedel-Craft acylation se: benzene AlCl₃ catalyst ki maujoodgi mein acyl chloride se react karta hai. C₆H₆ + CH₃COCl → (AlCl₃) C₆H₅COCH₃ + HCl.

book_ref.quote: Synthesis of acetophenone can be done by reaction between benzene and acyl chloride

blocks.prompt:
26 Compare the retrosynthesis of ethyl acetate with that of acetophenone.
(Ethyl acetate aur acetophenone ki retrosynthesis ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Ethyl acetate aur acetophenone

book_ref.quote: Synthesis of TM (acetophenone)

rows: Ester linkage ka disconnection (synthons CH₃CO⁺ aur C₂H₅O⁻)
C–C bond ka disconnection (synthons C₆H₅⁻ aur CH₃CO⁺)
Synthetic equivalents: acetic acid aur ethanol
Synthetic equivalents: benzene aur acyl chloride
H₂SO₄ ke saath esterification se synthesis
AlCl₃ ke saath Friedel-Craft acylation se synthesis

blocks.prompt:
27 Who first achieved the landmark synthesis of cholesterol, and when?
(Cholesterol ki tareekhi synthesis pehli dafa kis ne aur kab ki?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh pehli dafa 1950s ke shuru mein do muqabil groups ne ki jin ki qiyadat Oxford mein Robert Robinson aur Harvard mein R.B. Woodward kar rahe the.

book_ref.quote: The landmark synthesis of cholesterol was first achieved in early 1950s

blocks.prompt:
28 What is the known use of phenyl ethanoate in making medicines?
(Medicines banane mein phenyl ethanoate ka maloom istemal kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phenyl ethanoate paracetamol ke liye intermediate (darmiyani compound) ke taur par maloom hai: yeh 4-hydroxyacetophenone mein badal jata hai. (Yeh hepatitis medicines ka starting material nahi.)

book_ref.quote: Its known use in making medicines is as an intermediate for paracetamol

blocks.prompt:
29 What is meant by 'the beauty of organic synthesis' in pharmaceutical products?
(Pharmaceutical products mein 'organic synthesis ki khoobsurti' se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat se dawaai compounds bohat pecheeda lagte hain, lekin sahi aur mo'assar disconnection se woh saade aur aam milne wale starting materials tak le aate hain. Yun retrosynthesis pecheeda structure ko saada aur qabil-e-husool bana deti hai.

book_ref.quote: This is the beauty of organic synthesis

blocks.prompt:
30 Why is paracetamol disconnected at the C–N bond of its amide group?
(Paracetamol ko us ke amide group ke C–N bond par kyun disconnect kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke is se milne wale synthons ke synthetic equivalents, 4-aminophenol aur acyl chloride, nucleophilic addition-elimination reaction se react kar ke dobara amide banane ke liye mashhoor hain.

book_ref.quote: The first step is the disconnection of paracetamol from C—N bond in amide group to get synthons.

blocks.prompt:
31 Why is FGI used in the retrosynthesis of paracetamol?
(Paracetamol ki retrosynthesis mein FGI kyun istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 4-Aminophenol ko (FGI se) 4-nitrophenol mein badla jata hai kyun ke p-nitrophenol aasani se banta hai aur phir use reduce kar ke p-aminophenol banaya ja sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: FGI has been done because it is easy to prepare p-nitrophenol and it can then be reduced to p-aminophenol.

blocks.prompt:
32 Name the synthons and the synthetic equivalents obtained by disconnecting 4-nitrophenol at the C–N bond.
(4-Nitrophenol ko C–N bond par disconnect karne se milne wale synthons aur synthetic equivalents ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: 4-Nitrophenol ke synthons

book_ref.quote: The 4-hydroxy aryl anion is HO–C₆H₄⁻, not C₆H₅⁻ as printed.

blocks.prompt:
33 Which bond of aspirin is disconnected first, and what are the synthetic equivalents?
(Aspirin ka kaun sa bond pehle disconnect hota hai aur synthetic equivalents kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pehle ester linkage ka C–O bond disconnect hota hai. Synthons ko neutralize karne se salicylic acid aur acetic anhydride synthetic equivalents milte hain.

book_ref.quote: The first step is the disconnection of Aspirin from C—O bond in ester linkage to get synthons.

blocks.prompt:
34 How is salicylic acid traced back to phenol in the retrosynthesis of aspirin?
(Aspirin ki retrosynthesis mein salicylic acid ko phenol tak kaise pohanchaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carboxylic group ke C–C bond par Disconnection-II se. Synthons ko neutralize karne se synthetic equivalents phenol aur carbon dioxide milte hain.

book_ref.quote: Next disconnection is the C—C bond of carboxylic group.

blocks.prompt:
35 Compare the retrosynthesis of paracetamol and aspirin.
(Paracetamol aur aspirin ki retrosynthesis ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Paracetamol aur aspirin

book_ref.quote: Aspirin and Paracetamol, both are synthesized starting from phenol.

rows: Pehla disconnection: amide group ka C–N bond
Pehla disconnection: ester linkage ka C–O bond
SE: salicylic acid aur acetic anhydride
FGI nahi; doosra disconnection carboxylic group ke C–C bond par
Aakhri SE: phenol aur nitric acid
Aakhri SE: phenol aur carbon dioxide

blocks.text: 25.4 Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Drug Designing

blocks.prompt:
36 What problems in the development of new antibiotics are described in the chapter?
(Chapter mein nayi antibiotics banane ki kaun si mushkilaat bayan ki gayi hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pichhle kuch dahaiyon mein bohat kam nayi antibiotics bani hain aur woh bhi purani se thori si mukhtalif hain. Maujooda tareeqe bohat mehnge, waqt lene wale aur tang daaire tak mehdood hain, jab ke pathogens (jaraseem) aam antibiotics ke khilaf resistant ho rahe hain.

book_ref.quote: The past few decades have seen the development of very few new antibiotics.

blocks.prompt:
37 How was halicin identified by the MIT researchers?
(MIT ke researchers ne halicin kaise dhoonda?)
blocks.explanation: Unhon ne machine-learning algorithm banaya jo E. coli maarne wali chemical features dhoondta tha, ise 2500 molecules aur 800 natural products par lagaya, aur is ne aik molecule chuna jo antibacterial aur maujooda antibiotics se mukhtalif structure wala tha. Is ka naam halicin rakha gaya.

book_ref.quote: Once the computer model was applied to these compounds, it picked out one molecule

blocks.prompt:
38 What were the findings about halicin's toxicity and its action on bacteria from patients?
(Halicin ke zehreelepan aur mareezon ke bacteria par us ke asar ke baare mein kya nataij mile?)
blocks.explanation: Aik doosre model ne dikhaya ke yeh ghaliban insaani cells ke liye kam zehreela hai. Mareezon ke bacterial strains par test karne par is ne duniya ke bohat se mushkil bacteria maar diye jo pehle ilaaj ke khilaf resistant the.

book_ref.quote: it was tested against a number of bacterial strains isolated from patients

blocks.prompt:
39 What were the results of screening more than 100 million molecules with the computer model?
(Computer model se 10 crore se ziyada molecules ki screening ke kya nataij nikle?)
blocks.explanation: Screening sirf teen din mein hui aur is ne 23 mazeed molecules chune jin ke structures maujooda antibiotics se mukhtalif the; aath ne antibacterial activity dikhayi aur do khaas taur par taaqatwar the.

book_ref.quote: This screening was completed in only three days

blocks.prompt:
40 Which atom occupies the top position of both five-membered rings in halicin?
(Halicin ki dono paanch-rukni rings mein ooper wali jagah par kaun sa atom hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sulfur. Chhapa hua structure is atom ko khaali chhorta hai jis se carbon samjha jata hai, magar halicin mein dono rings mein yeh sulfur hai.

book_ref.quote: The printed structure leaves the top atom of both five-membered rings unlabelled

blocks.prompt:
41 Why is the total synthesis of vitamin B₁₂ called historic?
(Vitamin B₁₂ ki total synthesis ko tareekhi kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh R.B. Woodward aur A. Eschenmoser ne 1972 mein 10 saal se ziyada ke ishtiraak ke baad ki; is mein 100 se ziyada steps the aur 91 post-doctoral researchers aur 12 PhD students lage.

book_ref.quote: The historic total synthesis of vitamin B₁₂ was achieved by R.B. Woodward and A. Eschenmoser in 1972
